notes.title: Qiyb2
notes.notes: Qiyb2 is coming to Steam in about three weeks! New added cubes, reworked systems such as skills system, UI, luck / cube spawn system, backgrounds and bosses. The game was built from scratch in order to create a better code base and a more optimized game compared to Qiybz. Many ideas are planned to be released to the game Qiyb2 in the future after version 1.0. Wishlist the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531710/Qiyb2/]here[/url]!

notes.title: Qiybz 1.3
notes.notes:
Qiybz version 1.3

- Reduced the number of available versions to one, as the 'two versions' -system does not seem to work
- Added a shuffle option for soundtracks
- Added an option to stop music in the shop
- Added an option to force own music choices, such that no event or boss music rewrites the current choices
- Added score, life and star currency gain popup effects, the effects can be disabled in the effects tab in the shop
- Resolved some bugs regarding bosses
- Modified the function of some cubes
- Added a new cube 
- The pesky score border of 500 in order to enemy to spawn has been lowered to 5    
- The difficulty level of bosses has been increased, for example, an instant death cube has been introduced in boss 6, although the effect can be avoided with invulnerability effects   
- A new ability called height reset, use space to activate it    
- You can now cancel any skill during its effect by tapping the W button again, and gain a small time compensation in return   
- The time meters now get behind the pause menu   
- Added sound effects to three existing cubes    
- Modified some life giving cubes such that they give more lives the higher the score     
- Improved mechanics and synergies for some cubes

notes.title: Qiybz patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello!

If you have been a fan of Qiybz for a long time, thank you for your patience! We have made a couple of major changes to the game and also minor ones. The play button gives now two versions to play; the upper one is version 1.0 and the lower one is version 1.1. If you have played the game before, then the save should be found in the version 1.0. If you want to play the version 1.1, head to 'properties' of the game Qiybz, go to the section 'betas' , and change the option from empty / nothing to Qiybz 1.1. After this, click the button 'check code' without typing in any password, and the updated version should download. If you want to be extra sure that the game launches, check the file integrity of the game. Here is the list of changes for the patch 1.1:

-  The pesky score border of 500 in order to enemy to spawn has been lowered to 5
-  A new ability called height reset, use space to activate it. To prevent it from being too powerful, it has a cooldown.
-  You can now cancel any skill during its effect by tapping the W button again, and gain a small time compensation in return
-  The difficulty level of bosses has been increased, for example, an instant death cube has been introduced in boss 6, although the effect can be avoided with invulnerability effects
-  The time meters now get behind the pause menu
-  Added sound effects to three existing cubes
-  Modified some life giving cubes such that they give more lives the higher the score
-  Improved mechanics and synergies for some cubes

Please let us know if you have some ideas or feedback regarding this game! Are for example the final bosses too tough? Or too easy? Is the game too casual? Or should there be more complicated systems?

Have a great day!

notes.title: Qiybz becomes free as of April
notes.notes: Hey. The game Qiybz has not gained much traction. As I would like to see the playerbase grow but I don't have the resources to efficiently market my game, I am deciding to make this game free as of some date in April. Unfortunately I can not issue any refunds, but if the game succeeds at gaining noticeable traction, I might make more content in the future. Note that possible future dlc content may not be free, and may be intended for the more eager fans of the game. Aside from the possible paid content, there may also be free updates. All in all, the possible future content relies solely on how well the free base game gains traction, as I see no point in developing further a game that has no interest in the first place.
